rules: Restock requires an explicit merchant ID, canonical item ID, restock key, and target quantity.
Matching stock is scoped to merchant owner, merchant location, canonical item, and restock key.
Restock creates only the missing quantity and is idempotent at the projected target.
Existing stock identities are preserved; newly required quantities receive new runtime identities.
Stock above target is never silently deleted by restock.
Stackable stock obeys projected maximum_stack and ordinary destination reconciliation.
Classic activation remains fail-closed pending native evidence.
